references.text: 6b/46 Mount Gravatt Capalaba Rd, Upper Mount Gravatt QLD 4122 · Campbells Legal is a family-run law firm in Upper Mount Gravatt, on Brisbane's southside. Peter Campbell has advised Queenslanders since 1981 and now practises alongside his daughters, solicitors Mary and Madelaine Campbell. We handle conveyancing, commercial property and leasing, business and commercial law, wills and estate planning, probate and estate administration, personal injury claims, and family law. When you call, you speak to the solicitor handling your matter — not a case manager. Straightforward conveyancing and simple wills are fixed fee, quoted up front, and every matter starts with a written costs agreement. Serving Mount Gravatt, Mansfield, Wishart, Holland Park, Sunnybank, Carindale and throughout Queensland.
